title: access@1
description: The access words a manifest grants, from a closed list (technical-design.md, Access): files, programs, hosts, run-as-you, the screen, sound, the microphone, the camera, a device class as device:<class>, the clipboard, a window, the agent, edit_as_you, the record and canvas (a check runner's reads of canvas documents its grant names, #411). A device class is name@major, or a plug-in's own ext.<plug-in>.<name>@major. Any other word fails, naming it.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of access that adds a word
